name: Secret Detection Block
description: Blocks writes containing hardcoded secrets (API keys, tokens, passwords). Prevents credential leakage into code.

then.prompt: Before writing this file, verify it contains NO hardcoded secrets (API keys, tokens, passwords, private keys). If you detect any credential-like values that are not environment variable references or placeholder values, DO NOT proceed with the write. Instead, refactor to use environment variables or a secrets manager.
